strings: r_c0 checks and rechecks m_c's ears for {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. No matter how much {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} {VERB/r_c0/peer/peers} in, nothing reveals itself to be causing the horrible ringing m_c complains of.
m_c buries {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head into the nesting around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, but it still doesn't stop the sharp pain and ringing in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} ears.
m_c dizzily sways around camp, the swaying made worse due to the sharp painful ringing in one ear.
